scope: Structural supply only; no candidate returns or economic measurements
reason_inventory_cannot_be_built_from_ca: No row identifies a parent-child distribution, child CIK, historical share class, regular-way start, or filing acceptance time. First-observed-bar and symbol changes cannot establish that a security was a distributed spin-off child. Treating them as events would introduce false positives and possible current-identity leakage.
claims_not_verified: six concurrent eligible children commonly possible
one satellite slot continuously or intermittently occupied

external_structural_context_not_canonica.sample: U.S. nontaxable non-REIT spin events originating January 2001 to December 2012
external_structural_context_not_canonica.limitation: Historical commercial-source cohort; no post-2015 events, causal free-source mapping denominator, liquid-filter occupancy, or six-slot eligibility proof.

external_structural_context_not_canonica.source: Owers and Sergi, Humanities and Social Sciences Communications, 2021, full text
external_structural_context_not_canonica.limitation: Broader CRSP distribution-code and announcement-stage cohort; not verified strict full-spin child ordinary shares, regular-way entries, or liquid occupancy.

existing_causal_scanner_rules.status: Policy reference only; no threshold tuned and no attrition measured. A newly listed child needs enough trailing observations before these fields can be evaluated.

required_non_economic_acquisition: Create event rows from timestamped SEC/issuer public evidence with parent and child identifiers, distribution details, and explicitly documented regular-way session.
Resolve child CIK to the exact ordinary share class and historical symbol/entity; fail closed on ambiguity.
Join only verified event rows to canonical entity lifetimes and bars using valid-time identity; count eligible names and slot occupancy without looking ahead or computing returns.
